evidence.quote: And we are the customer zero for all of Snowflake products.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: So this is build on Snowflake co-work.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: So let's take Snowflake, okay?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: I don't know if you already said this, but I saw in the titles of the article Snowflake Intelligence, is that an underlying context or layer that the tool or system you built was on top of?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: Snowflake Intelligence, we renamed that to Snowflake Cowork a couple of weeks ago in our summit.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

entities.name: Cowork
entities.how_described: 本集说它是 Snowflake 的无代码智能体平台（几周前峰会上由 Snowflake Intelligence 改名而来），内含 Cortex Analyst、Cortex Search 等开箱即用工具，自带护栏，业务用户无需写一行代码即可部署智能体；本集的 go-to-market 助手就构建在它之上。

evidence.quote: Snowflake Intelligence, we renamed that to Snowflake Cowork a couple of weeks ago in our summit.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

entities.name: 智能体 (agent)
entities.how_described: 本集主线：一个回答了超百万个问题、每周约 4 万个的内部 go-to-market 智能体。嘉宾强调它是非确定性系统，用户信任极难赢得、一夜就能失去，因此质量优先于覆盖面；并描述了智能体从『和你的数据对话』到自动化工作流、团队自助构建、超个性化的演进，以及九页长智能体指令、用 Google Doc 管版本等发布细节。

evidence.quote: We had three lines of agent instructions.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: And then before I even tried the agent, I opened the spreadsheet, I took the sales process, I wrote down 150 questions.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: We don't have that data in the agent.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: Today, if you look into our agent, I mean, it's not a small agent.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: We literally have now sellers who are going to use our agent basically to monitor their inbox, then monitor their Slack channels, you know, keep track of all the customer questions coming about, like product questions, use the agent to draft responses that, save that in Gmail, review them afterwards, like send those things out, right?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: When we literally first launched the agent, it was a nine-page long agent instructions.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: And we were managing these agent instruction versions out of a Google Doc.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: We couldn't fit them into the agent instructions anymore.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: We hit the limits on the agent instructions.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: I'm clearly seeing what people are asking and we are not able to answer or where we have like a quality issue where they're swearing at the agent or like repeating their question so that we see where to improve.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: And in a couple of minutes, we can actually generate battle cards, sales enablement document, and then feed it back into the agent.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: We have blog posts on how we do agent instructions, how we do our structured data with semantic views, how we basically build our rack-based knowledge assistance, the non-technical side of the story, like how do you drive change management and so on.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: That's basically our non-code agent platform that we basically have available for our business users.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

entities.name: MCP
entities.how_described: 本集说系统接了五六个不同的 MCP 连接，靠它们做集成、支撑销售自动化工作流（监控收件箱和 Slack、起草回复存进 Gmail），是第二波能力浪潮的关键。

evidence.quote: We have, like, five to six different MCP connections on it, you know, close to 20 skills connected to that, and so on and so on, right?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: And the next wave comes with all the MCP connections, right?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

entities.name: 变革管理 (change management)
entities.how_described: 本集说『这是很多产品失败的地方』：发布两周后只有 20% 的人真正试用过产品，很多 AI 项目不是败在技术而是败在激活环节；嘉宾把 60-70% 的时间花在销售会议做演示、搭采用仪表盘、争取销售负责人背书，并说没做这件事今天可能只有一半的成果。

evidence.quote: It's basically how do you derive change management.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: And then you significantly invest in basically change management, in activation.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: And then as engineers, if you spend all your effort, you want to have a good product, make sure that the activation and the change management is lined up, like post-launch of the product as well.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: Change management.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: We have blog posts on how we do agent instructions, how we do our structured data with semantic views, how we basically build our rack-based knowledge assistance, the non-technical side of the story, like how do you drive change management and so on.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

entities.name: 语义视图 (semantic views)
entities.how_described: 本集说今天的智能体系统有 15 个语义视图、85 张表、3000 列数据；首版只有几个 Cortex Analyst 工具加语义视图，后续用语义视图做结构化数据，60% 的数据是上线后六七个月里才编辑的。

evidence.quote: We have 15 semantic views, 85 tables, 3,000 columns of data.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: It was a couple of Cortex analyst tools, semantic views.

evidence.quote: We have blog posts on how we do agent instructions, how we do our structured data with semantic views, how we basically build our rack-based knowledge assistance, the non-technical side of the story, like how do you drive change management and so on.

entities.name: 评估基础设施 (eval infrastructure)
entities.how_described: 本集说首版发布时没有这些，后来意识到 Google Doc 管版本行不通，才补上 CI/CD 和评估基础设施，包括单元测试、路由测试等。

evidence.quote: Let's figure out our basically eval infrastructure with all the unit tests, routing tests, and everything, right?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

entities.name: 技能 (skills)
entities.how_described: 本集说系统接了近 20 个技能；当业务流程塞不进智能体指令时，技能出现了，于是他们建了技能库，团队也能自助构建团队技能。

evidence.quote: We have, like, five to six different MCP connections on it, you know, close to 20 skills connected to that, and so on and so on, right?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: And now, all of a sudden, they're able to build team skills.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: And then the skills came, and we were like, oh, perfect.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

entities.name: 反馈回路 (feedback loop)
entities.how_described: 本集最后的核心建议：投资你的日志，用 LLM 对 120 万个问题做大规模分类，实时看到功能缺口和质量问题，自动生成作战卡和销售赋能文档再喂回智能体，还能做团队撮合——一旦开始挖掘日志，曲棍球杆式的指数增长就真的开始发生。

evidence.quote: Last thing is I would really, really recommend investing in your logs, okay, because they create basically the feedback loop.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: I mean, you cannot do that kind of a feedback loop with humans, right?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

entities.name: 留存率 (retention rate)
entities.how_described: 本集说 10% beta 阶段的核心验证指标是留存率：要证明用户会回来，他们退出 beta 时周活用户回访留存率超过 70%。

evidence.quote: So the things that we've really tracked there is basically like, okay, how many questions they're asking and everything, but what is the retention rate?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: So we exited, for example, that at like more than 70% retention rate that the weekly active users were coming back.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

entities.name: 护栏 (guardrails)
entities.how_described: 本集 Q&A 里说 Cowork 平台自带护栏，不用担心智能体在数据源使用上失控，团队因此能做大量策划和安全护栏。

evidence.quote: And it comes with the guardrails and things where you don't really need to worry about them going very crazy on what data sources to do things and so on.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02

evidence.quote: We are able to do a lot of security guardrails on there as well.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_02
